scope: Fixed finite L>log2, original Weil normalization, every active prime power and full signed pole term retained; U_alpha f=alpha^(-1/2)f(x/alpha), derivative at alpha=1. Written bounds hold for all such L; interval controls at L=9/4. Actual eigenvector tails are conditional on the stated lambda/residual band. No operator-core or H1_0 hypothesis silently imposed. Neither cofinal positivity nor the exact ground-state derivative is proved.
